Usage: oci generative-ai vector-store-connector-file-sync [OPTIONS] COMMAND
                                                          [ARGS]...

  The VectorStoreConnectorFileSync is an operation that carries out the data
  sync operation between the datasource and the VectorStore. The FileSync can
  be triggered either manually or at a scheduled interval by the
  VectorStoreConnector.

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  For detailed help on any of these individual commands, enter
                  <command> --help.

Commands:
  cancel  Cancels a vectorStoreConnectorFileSync.
  create  Creates a File Sync operation for a VectorStoreConnector.
  get     Gets information about a vectorStoreConnectorFileSync.
